quote: THE PURPOSE OF THIS GUIDEBOOK IS TO GET PEOPLE TO ASK THE RIGHT QUESTIONS.

speaker: RATIFIED_DOC

quote: The guidebook is not a prescription manual. It is not an authority on measurements.
subject: guidebook posture
claim: The guidebook is not a prescription manual and not an authority on measurements.
speaker: RATIFIED_DOC

quote: Measurements, ranges, and reference data exist to support this process — they serve the questions, not the other way around.
subject: role of measurements
claim: Measurements and reference data serve the questions, not the reverse.

quote: There is no generic ideal for any population.
subject: specification of an ideal
claim: A specification must not assert a generic ideal for a population.

quote: Specifications provide ranges and starting points — not definitive answers.
subject: specification form
claim: Specifications present ranges and starting points, not definitive answers.
speaker: RATIFIED_DOC

quote: DAR mandatory at all modes.

quote: Where higher-tier evidence exists, it governs.

quote: Code consensus across jurisdictions establishes what most codes agree on; it does not establish what is most accommodating or most dignified.

claim: Code consensus does not establish best practice.

quote: never rendered unflagged or above the weak band

quote: An unflagged or full-strength code-consensus best-practice claim is in error.
subject: code-consensus claim strength
claim: An unflagged or full-strength code-consensus best-practice claim is an error.

quote: ● = confirmed evidence base (T1, T2 both streams, T3-clinical, Co-1, Co-2).

subject: marker ◐
claim: ◐ marks a policy/standards basis only (T4, T5).

quote: A T4–6-only basis never renders best-practice language in any register

quote: Unmarked = error.

quote: Lived experience evidence (Co-1) is co-primary with Tier 1 on the claim types it anchors

quote: unconditionally, not merely where no clinical trial is feasible
